title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference

paragraphs.en: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs, and no law names the factors that set it. The most accurate SOTA model is a fit, not a law: it absorbs architecture into fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM fitting. What is therefore needed is a law expressed in the architecture’s own hyperparameters, one that names which of them govern the cost of a token, explicitly accounts for attention mechanism, and applies to unseen LLMs. We derive closed-form expressions of the computational and memory-access complexity of LLM inference in terms of architectural hyperparameters, covering Multi-Head Attention (MHA) and Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), and compare a family of analytical models of increasing granularity. From these, we obtain the S IMPLE I nference M odel to P redict L LMs E nergy ( SIMPLE ), a four-parameter law that separates prefill from decode, and decode into KV-cache cost and next-token computation. Over traces of 13 dense LLMs from six families (OPT, LLaMA, Gemma, Falcon, Qwen2, and Granite) on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it attains R 2 = 0.969 R^{2}=0.969 and 11.97 % 11.97\% MAPE, 3.1 − 3.5 × 3.1-3.5\times below the SOTA, without per-LLM calibration. The SIMPLE law explains as well as predicts: prefill energy grows quadratically with the hidden dimension, so larger LLMs suffer most from long inputs; and more aggressive GQA KV grouping reduces the per-token energy by up to 3 × 3\times relative to standard MHA. Increasing the reasoning token budget pushes output length beyond the analytically derived energy minimum, driving super-linear energy growth; although accuracy grows with the budget, energy grows faster, so Intelligence per Joule peaks at an intermediate budget and falls by up to 3.14 × 3.14\times across a 4.0 × 4.0\times reasoning-budget range. Agentic serving raises energy per request by 13.0 × 13.0\times relative to non-agentic ones, driven by the growth of both the prefill and the KV-cache terms with input length; while prefix caching removes most of the prefill cost ( − 93 % -93\% ), the KV-cache term is unaffected, so even a cached agentic request costs 4.8 × 4.8\times more. An interactive implementation of SIMPLE is available at ecs-lab/SIMPLE .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式AI按token计费，然而每个token的代价并不相同。 每个token都会进入KV-cache并抬高后续token的代价，因此在一段token看似完全相同的序列上，能耗会沿序列非线性地增长。 没有任何解析模型说明一个token的代价是多少，也没有任何定律指出决定该代价的因素。 最精确的SOTA模型是一种拟合而非定律：它将架构吸收进拟合系数中，因而需要对每个LLM单独拟合。 因此，需要的是一条以架构自身超参数表述的定律：它指明哪些超参数决定一个token的代价，显式地考虑注意力机制，并且能够应用于未见过的LLM。 我们以架构超参数为变量，推导出LLM推理的计算复杂度与内存访问复杂度的闭式表达式，涵盖多头注意力（MHA）与分组查询注意力（GQA），并比较了一系列粒度递增的解析模型。 由此，我们得到用于预测LLM能耗的简单推理模型（SIMPLE），这是一条四参数定律，它将预填充与解码分离，并把解码进一步分解为KV-cache代价与下一token计算。 在来自六个系列（OPT、LLaMA、Gemma、Falcon、Qwen2和Granite）的13个稠密LLM于NVIDIA H100 GPU上的运行轨迹中，该模型达到了R 2 = 0.969 R^{2}=0.969的R²与11.97 % 11.97\%的MAPE，比SOTA低3.1 − 3.5 × 3.1-3.5\times倍，且无需逐LLM校准。 SIMPLE定律不仅能够预测，也能解释：预填充能耗随隐藏维度呈二次增长，因此更大的LLM在长输入下受损最重；而更激进的GQA KV分组相对于标准MHA可将每token能耗降低至多3 × 3\times倍。 增加推理token预算会使输出长度超过解析推导出的能耗最小值，驱动超线性的能耗增长；虽然准确率随预算增长，但能耗增长得更快，因此每焦耳智能体智能（Intelligence per Joule）在某个中间预算处达到峰值，并在4.0 × 4.0\times倍的推理预算范围内最多下降3.14 × 3.14\times倍。 智能体式服务相对于非智能体式服务会使每请求能耗增加13.0 × 13.0\times倍，这是由预填充项与KV-cache项随输入长度增长所致；虽然前缀缓存能消除大部分预填充代价（ − 93 % -93\%），但KV-cache项不受影响，因此即使是已被缓存的智能体请求，其代价也要高出4.8 × 4.8\times倍。 SIMPLE的交互式实现可在 ecs-lab/SIMPLE 获取。

paragraphs.en: Inference, not training, is where most of the energy of a Large Language Model (LLM) is spent: a model is trained once and then served continuously, and inference accounts for up to 90% of its life-cycle energy [ 15 ] . Yet for an LLM not yet deployed, the only dependable way to know that cost is to build it, serve it, and measure it, an answer that arrives once the architecture is no longer a choice. The target is also moving: reasoning spends additional tokens to buy accuracy [ 21 ] , while agentic workflows [ 7 ] have pushed median prompt lengths from 750–1050 to 68K tokens [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 对于大语言模型（LLM）而言，耗费能量最多的阶段是推理而非训练：模型只需训练一次，随后便持续提供服务，而推理占其全生命周期能耗的高达 90% [ 15 ] 。 然而，对于一个尚未部署的 LLM，了解该成本的唯一可靠方法是构建它、部署它并对其进行测量，而等到答案出现时，架构已不再是可选项。 这个目标还在不断变化：推理通过消耗额外的 token 来换取准确性 [ 21 ] ，而智能体工作流 [ 7 ] 已将中位提示词长度从 750–1050 推高至 68K token [ 18 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The token is the unit of account of this economy. Inference is priced, billed, budgeted, and benchmarked per token [ 35 ] , and capacity is planned in tokens per second and tokens per joule. Yet no analytical model states what a token costs, and no law names the factors that set it. A token is an observable of the workload, not a unit of computational work: each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so average token energy depends on input length, generation length, context reuse, and how attention is organized. The consequence is already visible in the economics: using a model with a lower listed price per token can incur up to 28 × 28\times the total cost of using a nominally more expensive one [ 4 ] . An entire industry settles in a currency whose production cost cannot be computed.
paragraphs.zh: 代币是这个经济的记账单位。 推理按代币定价、计费、编制预算并进行基准测试[ 35 ]，而容量则以每秒代币数和每焦耳代币数来规划。 然而，没有任何分析模型说明一个代币的成本是多少，也没有任何定律指出决定这一成本的因素。 代币是工作负载的可观测量，而不是计算工作的单位：每个代币都会进入 KV 缓存并推高后续代币的成本，因此平均代币能耗取决于输入长度、生成长度、上下文复用以及注意力的组织方式。 这一后果已经在经济层面显现：使用标价每代币价格更低的模型，其总成本可能高达名义上更昂贵模型的 28 × 28\times 倍[ 4 ]。 一个完整的行业正在以一种其生产成本无法计算的货币进行结算。

paragraphs.en: Energy models exhibit the same gap in analytical form. Prior work fits energy as a function of input and output lengths [ 38 , 43 , 40 , 24 ] empirically, without deriving it from the computational kernels, thereby describing a measured regime rather than explaining it. SweetSpot [ 26 ] , the most accurate analytical formulation reported to date, removes the decisive obstacle by deriving the decode phase in closed form from the computation and memory accesses of decoder-only Transformer inference. SweetSpot , however, is a fit, not a law. Its coefficients are identified on a single LLM and carry that LLM’s architecture implicitly: the number of layers, the hidden dimension, and the organization of attention never appear as terms. The formulation therefore neither names the factors that set the cost of a token nor applies to a model it has not already measured, and later analytical models [ 36 , 11 , 22 ] relax this only in part.
paragraphs.zh: 能源模型在解析形式上表现出同样的差距。 已有工作以经验方式将能耗拟合为输入与输出长度的函数 [ 38 , 43 , 40 , 24 ]，而未从计算核心（kernel）中推导出来，因此只是描述了所测得的区间，而非对其进行解释。 SweetSpot [ 26 ] 是迄今报道的最精确的解析公式，它通过基于仅解码器 Transformer 推理的计算与内存访问，以闭式形式推导解码阶段，消除了决定性障碍。 然而，SweetSpot 是一种拟合，而非一条定律。 其系数是在单一 LLM 上辨识的，并隐式带有该 LLM 的架构：层数、隐藏维度以及注意力的组织结构从未作为项出现。 因此，该公式既未点明决定一个 token 成本的诸因素，也不适用于其尚未测量过的模型，而后续的解析模型 [ 36 , 11 , 22 ] 仅在部分程度上放宽了这一点。

paragraphs.en: This limitation is felt where decisions are now being made: in energy efficiency. Intelligence per Watt relates delivered capability to the power that produced it [ 27 ] , and serving is reported in tokens per joule [ 35 ] , but both are measured on systems that already exist. They rank deployments after the fact and cannot say which architecture would deliver the same capability for less, how many reasoning tokens are worth spending [ 21 ] , or at what context length serving an agentic request ceases to be affordable [ 18 ] . A measured efficiency locates no optimum. What is therefore needed is a law expressed in the architecture’s own hyperparameters, one that explains which of them govern the energy of a token, predicts that energy for an LLM never benchmarked, and thereby turns efficiency from something observed into something derived.
paragraphs.zh: 这一局限性在当前正在做出决策的领域感受得尤为明显：能效领域。 每瓦特智能将所交付的能力与产生该能力的功耗联系起来 [27]，而服务性能则以每焦耳的 token 数来报告 [35]，但两者都是在已经存在的系统上测量的。 这些指标只能事后对部署进行排名，却无法说明哪种架构能以更少的能耗交付同样的能力、值得花费多少推理 token [21]，以及在多大的上下文长度下服务一个智能体请求将变得不再可负担 [18]。 测得的效率无法定位任何最优点。 因此，我们需要一条以架构自身超参数表达的定律，它能解释哪些超参数支配一个 token 的能耗，为从未经过基准测试的 LLM 预测该能耗，从而将效率从被观测的对象转变为可推导的对象。

paragraphs.en: Modern LLMs share the decoder-only Transformer [ 37 ] and differ in a handful of hyperparameters and attention architectures: Multi-Head Attention (MHA) has largely given way to Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) [ 1 ] and Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) [ 9 ] , each cutting memory traffic and KV-cache size, and with them the energy per generated token [ 26 ] . Furthermore, long generations, 68K-token contexts, and mandatory prefix caching push today’s requests precisely into the regime where the KV-cache term dominates: no law of token cost can be blind to how attention is organized.
paragraphs.zh: 现代大语言模型共享 decoder-only Transformer 架构 [ 37 ] ，仅在少量超参数和注意力架构上有所差异：多头注意力（MHA）已在很大程度上被分组查询注意力（GQA）[ 1 ] 和多头潜在注意力（MLA）[ 9 ] 取代，二者都能减少内存流量和 KV 缓存大小，从而降低每生成一个 token 的能耗 [ 26 ] 。 此外，长文本生成、68K token 的上下文以及强制性的前缀缓存，使当今的请求恰好落入 KV 缓存项占主导的区间：任何关于 token 成本的规律都不能忽视注意力的组织方式。

paragraphs.en: Together, these considerations motivate the following open research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 综合以上考虑，这引出了以下开放性研究问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 : Is there an analytical model that can accurately predict inference energy across LLMs with different architectures, including the attention mechanism?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：是否存在一个能够准确预测不同架构（包括注意力机制）的大语言模型推理能耗的分析模型？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 : Can an LLM-agnostic model remain compact and accurate enough to be a practical alternative to LLM-specific models, while generalizing to unseen LLM architectures and workloads?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：一个与 LLM 无关的模型能否在泛化到未见过的 LLM 架构和工作负载的同时，保持足够紧凑和准确，从而成为 LLM 专用模型的实用替代方案？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 : How do LLM size and architectural hyperparameters influence inference energy consumption?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：LLM 的规模与架构超参数如何影响推理能耗？

paragraphs.en: RQ4 : How does the reasoning token budget affect inference energy and Intelligence per Joule?
paragraphs.zh: RQ4：推理 token 预算如何影响推理能耗和每焦耳智能（Intelligence per Joule）？

paragraphs.en: RQ5 : How does the energy cost of a single query shift from non-agentic to agentic workloads?
paragraphs.zh: RQ5：单次查询的能耗开销从非智能体负载转向智能体负载时会如何变化？

paragraphs.en: This work answers these with the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本工作通过以下贡献回答了这些问题：

paragraphs.en: We present a taxonomy of state-of-the-art LLM inference energy models, classified by functional form, grounding theory, and ability to predict inference energy across LLMs with different architectures, including the attention mechanism. We find that the most accurate model, SweetSpot [ 26 ] , absorbs architectural information implicitly into its fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM calibration and making it neither LLM-agnostic nor attention-aware. The SOTA therefore lacks an analytical model capable of accurately predicting the energy consumed by a generic request for an arbitrary LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对最先进的 LLM 推理能耗模型进行了分类，按函数形式、理论基础以及预测不同架构（包括注意力机制）的 LLM 推理能耗的能力进行归类。 我们发现最精确的模型 SweetSpot [26] 将架构信息隐式地吸收到其拟合系数中，需要对每个 LLM 单独校准，因此它既不与 LLM 无关，也无法感知注意力机制。 因此，现有最先进技术缺乏一个能够准确预测任意 LLM 处理通用请求所消耗能量的解析模型。

paragraphs.en: To close this gap, we analytically derive closed-form expressions for the computational and memory-access complexity of LLM inference, covering both MHA and GQA mechanisms Building on these, we propose the SIMPLE law, which separately models prefill and decode energy costs, further decomposing the latter into the self-attention KV-cache cost and the next-token computation (i.e., the feed-forward network). sents.en: We briefly review the fundamentals of LLM architectures, their computational characteristics, and the metrics used throughout the paper.
sents.zh: 我们简要回顾 LLM 架构的基础知识、其计算特性以及全文使用的指标。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are built on the Transformer architecture [ 37 ] , which has become the standard for generative AI. A Transformer block consists of two main components, the Multi-Head Self-Attention Mechanism (MHA) and the Feed-Forward Network (FFN), each wrapped in residual connections, layer normalization, and dropout. In MHA, the hidden representation is projected into several subspaces, corresponding to different heads . Each head learns to capture a different type of dependency within the sequence, and the head outputs are then combined. This improves the model’s expressivity and its ability to represent diverse relationships, but it also increases the number of operations in proportion to the number of heads. To reduce this overhead, Multi-Query Attention (MQA) was proposed in 2019 [ 29 ] . It keeps multiple query heads but shares a single set of Key-Value (KV) projections across all of them, which drastically reduces memory usage and KV-cache size during decoding and makes inference more efficient. More recently, Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) was introduced in 2023 [ 1 ] as a generalization of MHA and MQA: keys and values are shared within groups of heads, striking a balance between the efficiency of MQA and the expressivity of MHA. Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), introduced with DeepSeek-V2 [ 9 ] , provides a different mechanism to reduce the KV-cache footprint. Rather than sharing KV projections across heads, it compresses keys and values into a single low-rank latent vector. The full per-head keys and values are then recovered from this latent through up-projection matrices, preserving the expressivity of MHA at a fraction of the memory cost. Despite its distinct compression mechanism, MLA can nonetheless be seen as a variant of GQA [ 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型构建于Transformer架构之上[37]，该架构已成为生成式AI的标准。 一个Transformer块由两个主要组件构成，即多头自注意力机制（MHA）和前馈网络（FFN），每个组件都包裹在残差连接、层归一化和dropout之中。 在MHA中，隐藏表示被投影到若干子空间中，对应不同的头。 每个头学习捕捉序列中不同类型的依赖关系，随后各头的输出被组合起来。 这提升了模型的表达能力及其表示多样化关系的能力，但也使运算量随头的数量成比例增加。 为了减少这一开销，多查询注意力（MQA）于2019年被提出[29]。 它保留多个查询头，但在所有查询头之间共享单一的键值（KV）投影，这大幅降低了解码过程中的内存占用和KV缓存大小，使推理更加高效。 更近一些，分组查询注意力（GQA）于2023年被提出[1]，作为MHA和MQA的泛化形式：键和值在头组内共享，在MQA的效率与MHA的表达能力之间取得平衡。 多头潜在注意力（MLA）随DeepSeek-V2被提出[9]，提供了一种不同的机制来减少KV缓存的占用。 它并不在各头之间共享KV投影，而是将键和值压缩为单个低秩潜在向量。 完整的逐头键和值随后通过上投影矩阵从该潜在向量中恢复，在内存成本仅为一小部分的情况下保留了MHA的表达能力。 尽管其压缩机制独特，MLA仍可被视为GQA的一种变体[5]。

sents.zh: 这提升了模型的表达能力及其表示多样化关系的能力，但也使运算量随头的数量成比例增加。

sents.en: To reduce this overhead, Multi-Query Attention (MQA) was proposed in 2019 [ 29 ] .
sents.zh: 为了减少这一开销，多查询注意力（MQA）于2019年被提出[29]。

sents.en: It keeps multiple query heads but shares a single set of Key-Value (KV) projections across all of them, which drastically reduces memory usage and KV-cache size during decoding and makes inference more efficient.
sents.zh: 它保留多个查询头，但在所有查询头之间共享单一的键值（KV）投影，这大幅降低了解码过程中的内存占用和KV缓存大小，使推理更加高效。

sents.en: More recently, Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) was introduced in 2023 [ 1 ] as a generalization of MHA and MQA: keys and values are shared within groups of heads, striking a balance between the efficiency of MQA and the expressivity of MHA.
sents.zh: 更近一些，分组查询注意力（GQA）于2023年被提出[1]，作为MHA和MQA的泛化形式：键和值在头组内共享，在MQA的效率与MHA的表达能力之间取得平衡。

sents.en: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), introduced with DeepSeek-V2 [ 9 ] , provides a different mechanism to reduce the KV-cache footprint.
sents.zh: 多头潜在注意力（MLA）随DeepSeek-V2被提出[9]，提供了一种不同的机制来减少KV缓存的占用。

sents.en: Rather than sharing KV projections across heads, it compresses keys and values into a single low-rank latent vector.
sents.zh: 它并不在各头之间共享KV投影，而是将键和值压缩为单个低秩潜在向量。

sents.en: The full per-head keys and values are then recovered from this latent through up-projection matrices, preserving the expressivity of MHA at a fraction of the memory cost.
sents.zh: 完整的逐头键和值随后通过上投影矩阵从该潜在向量中恢复，在内存成本仅为一小部分的情况下保留了MHA的表达能力。

sents.en: Despite its distinct compression mechanism, MLA can nonetheless be seen as a variant of GQA [ 5 ] .
sents.zh: 尽管其压缩机制独特，MLA仍可被视为GQA的一种变体[5]。

paragraphs.en: In large-scale models, most of the learnable weights, referred to as parameters, reside in the FFN layers, whereas the runtime complexity is dominated by the attention mechanism, owing to its quadratic dependence on the input sequence length. The total number of parameters, typically in the billions, is referred to as model size. LLM inference is typically split into two phases: prefill , in which the entire input sequence is processed in parallel to initialize the KV-cache, and decode , in which tokens are generated autoregressively [ 42 ] . During prefill, the computational cost is dominated by the quadratic attention term; during decode, thanks to the reuse of cached keys and values, the cost per token grows only linearly with the sequence length. Nevertheless, for long outputs, the decode phase often accounts for most of the total inference time, since tokens must be produced one at a time, which restricts the opportunities for parallelization. On modern GPUs, the throughput of LLM inference is constrained not only by arithmetic performance but also by memory bandwidth. Storing and retrieving the large KV-cache during decoding places considerable stress on the memory subsystem. For example, in autoregressive decoding, every generated token requires loading all previous keys and values from memory, which makes attention kernels strongly memory-bound, especially for long contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 在大规模模型中，大部分可学习的权重（称为参数）位于 FFN 层中，而运行时复杂度则由注意力机制主导，因为其对输入序列长度呈二次依赖关系。 参数总量通常以十亿计，称为模型规模。 大语言模型（LLM）推理通常分为两个阶段：预填充（prefill），即并行处理整个输入序列以初始化 KV 缓存；以及解码（decode），即以自回归方式逐个生成词元 [42]。 在预填充阶段，计算开销主要由二次方的注意力项主导；在解码阶段，得益于缓存键值对的复用，每个词元的开销仅随序列长度线性增长。 尽管如此，对于较长的输出，解码阶段往往占总推理时间的绝大部分，因为词元必须逐个生成，这限制了并行化的机会。 在现代 GPU 上，大语言模型推理的吞吐量不仅受算术性能的约束，还受内存带宽的约束。 在解码期间存储和读取庞大的 KV 缓存会给内存子系统带来相当大的压力。 例如，在自回归解码中，每生成一个词元都需要从内存中加载之前所有的键和值，这使得注意力内核呈现强烈的访存受限特性，尤其是在长上下文场景下。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on LLM inference energy falls broadly into two categories: (i) experimental characterization of energy consumption, and (ii) analytical or empirical models for predicting it. We review each in turn, then position our contributions with respect to the identified limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 关于大语言模型推理能耗的近期工作大致分为两类：（i）对能耗的实验性表征，以及（ii）用于预测能耗的解析或经验模型。 我们依次回顾这两类工作，然后结合已识别的局限性来定位我们的贡献。

sents.en: Recent work on LLM inference energy falls broadly into two categories: (i) experimental characterization of energy consumption, and (ii) analytical or empirical models for predicting it.

paragraphs.en: Several studies have characterized LLM inference energy across different workloads and hardware conditions. Samsi et al. [ 28 ] benchmark energy for LLaMA models of varying sizes across two NVIDIA GPU generations (V100 and A100), including multi-node and multi-GPU execution. Chung et al. [ 6 ] introduce ML.ENERGY , a benchmark suite for measuring energy under realistic serving conditions across different tasks, and show that automated configuration recommendations can reduce consumption. Stojkovic et al. [ 31 ] study how inference server configurations affect latency, throughput, and energy. Maliakel et al. [ 19 ] examine the effect of GPU Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) settings on energy for different workloads. Fernandez et al. [ 13 ] analyze energy across inference optimization strategies and task types. Wilhelm et al. [ 39 ] investigate the accuracy–energy trade-off, focusing on how inference strategies such as chain-of-thought affect it.
paragraphs.zh: 已有多项研究对不同工作负载和硬件条件下的大语言模型推理能耗进行了刻画。Samsi 等人 [ 28 ] 针对两种 NVIDIA GPU 代际（V100 和 A100）上不同规模的 LLaMA 模型进行了能耗基准测试，包括多节点和多 GPU 执行。Chung 等人 [ 6 ] 提出了 ML.ENERGY，一套用于测量不同任务在真实服务条件下能耗的基准套件，并表明自动化配置推荐可以降低能耗。Stojkovic 等人 [ 31 ] 研究了推理服务器配置如何影响延迟、吞吐量和能耗。Maliakel 等人 [ 19 ] 考察了 GPU 动态电压频率调节（DVFS）设置对不同工作负载能耗的影响。Fernandez 等人 [ 13 ] 分析了不同推理优化策略和任务类型下的能耗。Wilhelm 等人 [ 39 ] 研究了准确率与能耗之间的权衡，重点关注思维链等推理策略如何影响这一权衡。

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, Niu et al. [ 22 ] is the only existing work to propose an attention-aware energy model for LLM inference. Their model estimates the energy per output token of a single decode step, expressing decode energy as a linear function of the bytes accessed, considering both the model weights and the KV-cache, and the measured decode time. The KV-cache byte term is analytically derived from the model architecture and attention mechanism: it is explicitly parametrized by the number of KV heads per layer ( N k ​ v N_{kv} ), which accounts for MHA and GQA. The decode time, however, must be measured at runtime. The resulting model requires a separate calibration and fit for each LLM and hardware configuration. Since the model covers only the decode phase energy, excluding the prefill, it is not directly applicable to predict the total inference energy E tot E_{\text{tot}} for a given query, which is the focus of this work. We therefore do not consider it further here.

We address the key limitations of previous approaches by extending the derivation of the computational and memory-access complexities of SweetSpot [ 26 ] to GQA, and using the resulting expressions to derive SIMPLE , a compact LLM-agnostic model that explicitly represents the attention mechanism, builds on SweetSpot ’s interpretable quadratic structure to expose the role of individual architectural hyperparameters, and predicts energy across multiple LLM architectures without per-LLM calibration.

sents.en: We address the key limitations of previous approaches by extending the derivation of the computational and memory-access complexities of SweetSpot [ 26 ] to GQA, and using the resulting expressions to derive SIMPLE , a compact LLM-agnostic model that explicitly represents the attention mechanism, builds on SweetSpot ’s interpretable quadratic structure to expose the role of individual architectural hyperparameters, and predicts energy across multiple LLM architectures without per-LLM calibration.
sents.zh: 我们通过将 SweetSpot [26] 的计算与内存访问复杂度的推导扩展到 GQA，并利用所得表达式推导出 SIMPLE，从而解决了以往方法的关键局限；SIMPLE 是一个紧凑的、与 LLM 无关的模型，它显式地表示注意力机制，建立在 SweetSpot 可解释的二次结构之上以揭示各个架构超参数的作用，并且无需针对每个 LLM 进行校准即可预测多种 LLM 架构的能耗。

paragraphs.en: Throughout our study, we target the Energy-per-Token E tok E_{\text{tok}} , rather than total energy consumption E tot E_{\text{tot}} , since normalizing by τ out \tau_{\text{out}} isolates the cost of generation from the cost of processing the input, exposing the trade-off between amortizing the prefill cost over more output tokens and incurring additional decode cost as τ out \tau_{\text{out}} grows. Moreover, E tok E_{\text{tok}} serves as a natural unit for comparison across different workloads and deployments, as it corresponds directly to operational metrics such as cost-per-token and tokens-per-joule, matching how inference is commonly priced and provisioned in production.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的整个研究中，我们以每词元能耗 E tok E_{\text{tok}} 为目标，而不是总能耗 E tot E_{\text{tot}}，因为通过 τ out \tau_{\text{out}} 进行归一化可以将生成的成本与处理输入的成本分离开来，从而揭示在更多输出词元上摊销预填充成本与随 τ out \tau_{\text{out}} 增长而产生额外解码成本之间的权衡。 此外，E tok E_{\text{tok}} 是在不同工作负载和部署之间进行比较的天然单位，因为它直接对应于每词元成本和每焦耳词元数等运营指标，与生产环境中通常对推理进行定价和供给的方式相吻合。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present the analytical derivation of the Floating-Point Operations ( FLOPs ) and Memory Operations ( MemOPs ) of LLM inference based on a decoder-only Transformer, distinguishing the prefill and decode phases and assuming no quantization of weights or KV-cache. In the following derivations, we consider a dense LLM and a constant batch size, extending the derivation of SweetSpot [ 26 ] to include the GQA mechanism.

paragraphs.en: The dataset comprises synthetic requests processed using trtllm-bench configured in throughput mode, with request concurrency set to 1000 and a maximum batch size of 1024. The maximum sequence length and the maximum number of batched tokens are both set to 8192. The experiments were conducted using one GPU per run on a server equipped with an Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ CPU and four NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs connected via NVLink. Input and output lengths independently span 64–4096 tokens in powers of two, yielding 49 combinations with 1000 requests each. GPU power was sampled every 500 ms using pynvml [ 8 ] . The per-query energy was obtained by multiplying the average GPU power over 1000-request by the total measurement time, and dividing by the number of requests. Since neither the baseline models nor the SIMPLE model explicitly accounts for batching, we use these fixed settings, and fit energy per individual request.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集包含通过以吞吐量模式配置的 trtllm-bench 处理的合成请求，请求并发数设为 1000，最大批处理大小设为 1024。 最大序列长度和最大批处理 token 数均设为 8192。 实验在配备 Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ CPU 和四块通过 NVLink 互连的 NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU 的服务器上进行，每次运行使用一块 GPU。 输入和输出长度独立地以二的幂在 64–4096 个 token 之间取值，共产生 49 种组合，每种组合包含 1000 个请求。 GPU 功率使用 pynvml [ 8 ] 每 500 毫秒采样一次。 每次查询的能耗是通过将 1000 个请求上的平均 GPU 功率乘以总测量时间，再除以请求数得到的。 由于基线模型和 SIMPLE 模型都没有显式考虑批处理，我们使用这些固定设置，并对每个单独请求的能耗进行拟合。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 reports the average tokens per joule computed on the 49 different workload configurations across the different LLMs in the dataset. Smaller models and GQA-based architectures generally achieved higher efficiency (Figure 1 ): Llama 3.2 1B reached 55.91 tok/J, compared with 5.12 tok/J for Falcon-RW 7B. Among similarly sized models, Qwen2 1.5B (GQA R=1/7) achieved 49.06 tok/J versus 20.66 tok/J for OPT 1.3B (MHA R=1). paragraphs.en: When comparing LOOCV results, SOTA approaches of Zhan et al. [ 43 ] and Vartziotis et al. [ 36 ] achieve R 2 R^{2} values of 0.456 0.456 and 0.645 0.645 , respectively. The proposed LLM-agnostic SweetSpot outperforms SOTA models, reaching an R 2 R^{2} of 0.780 0.780 , showing that extending the previously proposed SweetSpot formulation with LLM architectural hyperparameters makes it LLM-agnostic, able to predict across LLMs without separate per-model fits, improving MAPE from 69.444 to 30.390. Despite being more accurate than SOTA models, its accuracy is far from optimal. Among OPs-centric models, Fine-Grained is the most accurate, reaching R 2 = 0.945 R^{2}=0.945 , while FLOPs-MemOPs and Prefill-Decode obtain substantially lower R 2 R^{2} of 0.551 0.551 and 0.522 0.522 , respectively. This shows that considering only one coefficient per operation (FLOPs and MemOPs) or per inference phase lowers the attainable accuracy, which drops by 2.7 × 2.7\times in MAPE compared to Fine-Grained .

paragraphs.en: Reasoning (or thinking) is widely referred to as the process of generating intermediate tokens before producing the final response, thereby leveraging additional test-time computation to improve accuracy [ 21 , 30 ] . Throughout this section, we refer to the total number of generated tokens, including explicit reasoning tokens, as the reasoning token budget . Since SIMPLE already models all generated tokens as τ out \tau_{\text{out}} , increasing the reasoning token budget directly increases τ out \tau_{\text{out}} and hence E tot E_{\text{tot}} . To assess how this energy cost translates into reasoning efficiency, we combine the E tot E_{\text{tot}} predicted by SIMPLE with task accuracy, measured as Intelligence per Joule (IPJ = = accuracy / E tot ) /~E_{\text{tot}}) . We draw on results from [ 30 ] , which reported the accuracy of a set of SOTA LLMs (including Qwen3-1.7B [ 34 ] and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B [ 10 ] ) on widely used benchmarks while varying reasoning budget.

paragraphs.en: So far, SOTA works [ 11 , 24 , 12 ] have focused on evaluating the environmental impact of conversational AI. Agentic AI workloads are changing this landscape, and no existing work proposes a theoretical framework that can capture and explain the resulting transformation in energy cost, as they lack a way of accounting for prompt/prefix caching. Liu et al. [ 18 ] present an extensive analysis of the GitHub Copilot [ 7 ] coding agent production workload. Unlike conversational AI, characterized by queries with a median prompt length ( τ in \tau_{\text{in}} ) of 750–1050 tokens and a median completion length ( τ out \tau_{\text{out}} ) of 80–105, the reported agentic workload follows a long-tail distribution with a median context length ( τ in \tau_{\text{in}} ) of 68K tokens and a median completion length of 247 tokens. Moreover, they report a median prefix KV-cache of 63K tokens, which corresponds to a hit rate of ≈ 93 % \approx 93\% . This means that in the average query only 5K input tokens (out of 68K) are newly computed in the prefill stage.
paragraphs.zh: 迄今为止，最先进的工作 [11, 24, 12] 主要聚焦于评估对话式 AI 的环境影响。 智能体 AI 工作负载正在改变这一格局，但现有工作尚未提出一个能够捕捉并解释由此带来的能源成本变化的理论框架，原因在于它们缺乏对提示词/前缀缓存进行核算的方法。Liu 等人 [18] 对 GitHub Copilot [7] 编程智能体的生产工作负载进行了广泛分析。 与对话式 AI 不同——后者的特点是查询的中位提示长度（τ in \tau_{\text{in}}）为 750–1050 个词元，中位补全长度（τ out \tau_{\text{out}}）为 80–105——该报告的智能体工作负载呈长尾分布，中位上下文长度（τ in \tau_{\text{in}}）为 68K 个词元，中位补全长度为 247 个词元。 此外，他们报告的中位前缀 KV 缓存为 63K 个词元，对应约 93 % \approx 93\% 的命中率。 这意味着在平均查询中，仅有 5K 个输入词元（68K 中的 5K）需要在预填充阶段进行新计算。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 quantifies this effect for Llama 3.1 8B on the median GitHub Copilot request, comparing three scenarios. In the non-agentic scenario, for which we consider only the non-cached input ( τ in = 5 \tau_{\text{in}}=5 K, τ c = 0 \tau_{\text{c}}=0 ), the request costs 138.1 J, with Prefill (88.8 J) as the dominant term and the KV-cache contribution (43.2 J) playing a secondary role. Moving to the agentic scenario ( τ in = 68 \tau_{\text{in}}=68 K, τ c = 0 \tau_{\text{c}}=0 ), both context-dependent terms grow approximately proportionally to τ in \tau_{\text{in}} : Prefill increases by 13.6 × 13.6\times and KV-cache by 13.3 × 13.3\times , while the Next-token term is unchanged, bringing E tot E_{\text{tot}} to 1787.7 J ( 13.0 × 13.0\times ). Prefix caching ( τ in = 68 \tau_{\text{in}}=68 K, τ c = 63 \tau_{\text{c}}=63 K) is highly effective on the Prefill term in this setting: only the 5K uncached tokens are processed, reducing Prefill contribution back to 88.8 J ( − 93 % -93\% ) and reducing E tot E_{\text{tot}} by 2.7 × 2.7\times (668.7 J). paragraphs.en: This paper presented the SIMPLE law, an architecture-aware closed-form expression for predicting the energy cost of dense decoder-only LLM inference, derived from the computational and memory-access complexity of the prefill and decode phases. SIMPLE expresses energy consumption with a compact and interpretable formulation, which explains prefill and decode energy costs as a function of LLM architectural hyperparameters and input/output sequence lengths. By explicitly modeling the attention mechanism, SIMPLE closes a gap in the literature, as the first analytical energy law able to generalize across LLM architectures. With only four parameters fitted once across all LLMs, it reduces the error of previous SOTA models by 3.1–3.5 × \times , reaching a MAPE of 11.97%.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 SIMPLE 定律，这是一种面向架构的闭式表达式，用于预测稠密 decoder-only 大语言模型推理的能耗，其推导基于 prefill 阶段与 decode 阶段的计算与内存访问复杂度。 SIMPLE 以紧凑且可解释的公式表达能耗，将 prefill 与 decode 的能耗解释为大语言模型架构超参数以及输入/输出序列长度的函数。 通过显式建模注意力机制，SIMPLE 填补了文献中的空白，成为首个能够在大语言模型架构之间泛化的解析能耗定律。 仅需在所有大语言模型上一次性拟合四个参数，SIMPLE 就能将先前 SOTA 模型的误差降低 3.1–3.5 × \times 倍，达到 11.97% 的 MAPE。

paragraphs.en: Beyond predictive accuracy, the SIMPLE law quantitatively explains three of the most prominent effects in modern LLM inference: how LLM size and architecture affect energy cost, how the reasoning token budget drives super-linear energy growth and shapes the Intelligence per Joule, and how agentic AI transforms energy consumption. Taken together, these results establish the SIMPLE law as an analytical foundation for sustainable LLM inference.
paragraphs.zh: 除预测精度之外，SIMPLE 定律还定量解释了现代大语言模型推理中最突出的三种效应：大语言模型的规模与架构如何影响能耗、推理 token 预算如何驱动超线性的能耗增长并塑造每焦耳智能，以及智能体 AI 如何改变能耗。 综合来看，这些结果确立了 SIMPLE 定律作为可持续大语言模型推理的分析基础。

paragraphs.en: Our approach is subject to a few limitations, which we group into three categories. First, our evaluation is restricted to dense, single-GPU LLMs and does not cover mixture-of-experts models. We also restrict our evaluation to MHA and GQA attention mechanisms; validation on more recent attention variants, LLM sizes, and architectures is left for future work. Second, the SIMPLE law does not explicitly model batch size or the number of concurrent requests as hyperparameters of the formulation. We plan to explicitly incorporate such additional workload parameters to extend the law. Finally, the reference dataset was collected using TensorRT-LLM on a single H100 GPU. Therefore, the SIMPLE law captures the energy behavior of single-device inference, and does not account for the additional costs of multi-GPU deployments, such as inter-device communication, tensor or pipeline parallelism, and distributed KV-cache management. As such, the fitted coefficients are specific to this hardware-framework pair. How the coefficients would change using other accelerators, multi-GPU deployments, and other inference frameworks remains to be explored in future work.
